operations.result: current philosophy projection fingerprints for traceable local proposal binding

result.matching: Python lower and strip query normalization; recursively searches JSON string values only, not object keys, numbers, or serialized punctuation
result.ordering: owner-defined collection order, then original source ordinal
result.corpus_filter: optional exact resource_kind filter, echoed in the result

operations.cloudflare_worker_profile: The D1 Worker admits these value-search semantics only when the bounded public_d1_producer_profile metadata declares tos-rust-public-d1-full-v2, read_model_schema v9, and the same data_revision as the D1 data_revision cell. Missing or older profile returns HTTP 503 until a matching publication is imported.
operations.cloudflare_worker_budget: Query and filter fields are bounded to 1 MiB. One global ordered scan across D1 pages admits at most 100000 candidates, 64 MiB candidate input, 100000000 work steps and 16 MiB response bytes, with 2 MiB per stored candidate field. Exceeded work, scan, input or response budgets return HTTP 413; invalid requests return HTTP 400; unavailable or corrupt selected rows return HTTP 503.

operations.result: tos_knowledge_search_indexed_v2 or tos_knowledge_search_compressed_v3 packet selected from /api/knowledge/search/capabilities; the page adapter adds search_mode and preserves the native packet schema and opaque cursor
operations.engine_selection: An eligible mode is advertised available and meets its min_normalized_query_code_points, counted after native Unicode strip and lowercase normalization. Explicit search_mode must be eligible. Otherwise prefer eligible indexed, then eligible compressed; refuse before search when neither qualifies. Bind advertised source_revision to the catalog revision when supplied. Never fall back to legacy or retry a rejected query through another engine. Continuation retains the selected mode; projection search remains tos.search.

input.document_types: optional exact selected document type IDs; at most 100
input.source_paths: optional exact selected source paths; at most 100
input.cursor: optional opaque continuation token; at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes

operations.result: bounded source-text page (operation_profile=tos_source_text_search_v1) from the explicitly selected durable PostgreSQL source-text consumer; includes selected consumer/profile and source custody references. Non-current or over-budget selections return an explicit refusal. It reports only the selected private projection's currentness and source-read posture, not public rights, canon, or publication admission.
operations.available_on: native local HTTP, CLI and MCP only with an explicitly selected durable PostgreSQL consumer. Cloudflare Worker can forward to the existing native endpoint only when its HTTPS origin, outbound Access service-token pair, and inbound Access issuer plus application audience are configured. The Worker verifies the caller JWT against the configured issuer; the owner must bind that application audience and Access Allow policy to the principal set admitted for the native private delivery scope. Capability reports configuration only, with runtime readiness not probed. D1 remains unavailable as a source-text reader.

input.export: boolean (optional; true selects the full table, excluding offset/limit)
input.full_projection: constant true (MCP/native only; optional exclusive branch, false rejected; true is the sole argument and selects the complete Original header plus every base node/edge; excludes all table/view/layers/export/page arguments)

operations.result: bounded scale rows packet; full table export uses one held native snapshot; the exclusive full_projection branch returns the complete v1/v2 Original carrier in receipt order; either branch refuses when its existing selected work/output budget is exceeded
